composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 (196D5023, GMMS-series BAE electrical wiring) shows two BEL SYNC/CAN-A/chain-connector modules — BEL1-S and BEL2-S — each a terminal-block interface for one BEL (inverter) unit's synchronization, CAN-bus, chain, and battery-return wiring. The "-S" suffix and mirrored pinout (identical to a "-P" pattern seen elsewhere in this drawing set) indicate these are the STBD-side BEL sync/CAN interfaces, i.e. BEL1 STBD and BEL2 STBD, matching register nodes 629-bel1-s and 629-bel2-s. The BEL, SYNC, and CAN-A boxes drawn beside each terminal block are the actual inverter unit and its onboard sync/CAN connector pins that the terminal block wires to.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal block labeled BEL1-S wires directly into a BEL unit's RTN1 and SYNC pins and a CAN-A connector; per established facts BEL1-S is already identified as a BEL converter node, so this sheet's loop data attaches there.

functions.label: BEL1-S SYNC / chain loop
functions.what_it_does: Carries the BEL1 chain-output/sync signal from the BEL1-S terminal block to the BEL unit's onboard SYNC connector, establishing the inverter's synchronization chain link with its return.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT from BEL1-S pin 11 via wire to BEL SYNC connector pin 10; G3-S3S2 SYNC from BEL1-S pin 3 via wire to BEL SYNC connector pin 3 (wires cross/twist per drawn X-routing between terminal block and SYNC connector)
G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN routes from BEL1-S pin 7 (VBATTERY RTN / RTN1) to BEL RTN1 pin, closing the sync-chain return loop

functions.dry_data: Terminal block BEL1-S, pins 3/7/10/11; wire ids G3-S321, G3-S3S2, G3-S3R1, G3-S3S1.

functions.label: BEL1-S CAN-A bus interface
functions.what_it_does: Connects BEL1's CAN-A differential pair and shield from the terminal block to the BEL unit's CAN-A connector for bus communication (address/enable lines present but not wired).

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3AH CANA_HI from BEL1-S pin 5 via crossed wire to CAN-A connector HI; G3-S3AL CANA_LO from BEL1-S pin 6 via crossed wire to CAN-A connector LO; G3-S3AS CANA_Shield from BEL1-S (N/C pin) via wire to CAN-A connector Shield
ENABLE (pin1), ADR_0 (pin8), ADR_1 (pin9) all terminate N/C at BEL1-S — no drawn connection onward

functions.dry_data: Pins 5/6/N/C on BEL1-S wired to CAN-A HI/LO/Shield; ENABLE/ADR_0/ADR_1 not connected.

functions.label: BEL1-S FREQ_SELECT and CHAIN_SUPPLY
functions.what_it_does: Provides frequency-select command line and chain-supply feed pins for BEL1's chain synchronization scheme.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT at BEL1-S pin 2 — no drawn destination on this sheet (dead-ends off-sheet)
G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY at BEL1-S pin 10 — no drawn destination on this sheet (dead-ends off-sheet)

functions.dry_data: Pins 2 and 10 on BEL1-S; wire ids G3-S3S1, G3-S3S3 — routing continues on another sheet.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal block labeled BEL2-S wires directly into a second BEL unit's RTN1 and SYNC pins (pins 9/4 rather than 10/3) and a second CAN-A connector; matches established BEL2-S converter node.

functions.label: BEL2-S SYNC / chain loop
functions.what_it_does: Carries the BEL2 chain-output/sync signal from the BEL2-S terminal block to the BEL unit's onboard SYNC connector, establishing the inverter's synchronization chain link with its return.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S421 CHAIN_OUTPUT from BEL2-S pin 11 via wire to BEL SYNC connector pin 9; G3-S4S2 SYNC from BEL2-S pin 3 via wire to BEL SYNC connector pin 4 (wires cross/twist per drawn X-routing between terminal block and SYNC connector)
G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN routes from BEL2-S pin 7 (VBATTERY RTN / RTN1) to BEL RTN1 pin, closing the sync-chain return loop

functions.dry_data: Terminal block BEL2-S, pins 3/7/10/11; wire ids G3-S421, G3-S4S2, G3-S4R1, G3-S4S1.

functions.label: BEL2-S CAN-A bus interface
functions.what_it_does: Connects BEL2's CAN-A differential pair and shield from the terminal block to the BEL unit's second CAN-A connector for bus communication (address/enable lines present but not wired).

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S4AH CANA_HI from BEL2-S pin 5 via crossed wire to CAN-A connector HI; G3-S4AL CANA_LO from BEL2-S pin 6 via crossed wire to CAN-A connector LO; G3-S4AS CANA_Shield from BEL2-S (N/C pin) via wire to CAN-A connector Shield
ENABLE (pin1), ADR_0 (pin8), ADR_1 (pin9) all terminate N/C at BEL2-S — no drawn connection onward

functions.dry_data: Pins 5/6/N/C on BEL2-S wired to CAN-A HI/LO/Shield; ENABLE/ADR_0/ADR_1 not connected.

functions.label: BEL2-S FREQ_SELECT and CHAIN_SUPPLY
functions.what_it_does: Provides frequency-select command line and chain-supply feed pins for BEL2's chain synchronization scheme.

flow_scenarios.path: G3-S4S1 FREQ_SELECT at BEL2-S pin 2 — no drawn destination on this sheet (dead-ends off-sheet)
G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY at BEL2-S pin 10 — no drawn destination on this sheet (dead-ends off-sheet)

functions.dry_data: Pins 2 and 10 on BEL2-S; wire ids G3-S4S1, G3-S4S3 — routing continues on another sheet.

uncertainties: FREQ_SELECT (pin 2) and CHAIN_SUPPLY (pin 10) on both BEL1-S and BEL2-S have no drawn onward connection on this sheet — likely continue to another BAE electrical sheet not provided here; not guessed.

Sheet does not explicitly label BEL1-S/BEL2-S as PORT or STBD; assignment to the -s (STBD) register nodes is inferred from naming convention and prior established facts pattern (BEL1-P/BEL2-P elsewhere), not from an explicit PORT/STBD callout on this sheet itself.
